speaker: dad
igboText: Nwa m nwanyị, nwa nwa m chọrọ ịga lelee ọdịdị nke ụwa taa.
englishText: My daughter, my grandchild wants to go explore nature today.
statement: Dad says his grandchild wants to explore nature today.
falseStatement: Dad says his daughter wants to explore nature today.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Eziokwu? Ọ ga-enwe ọṅụ na ya!
statement: The daughter says he will enjoy it.
falseStatement: The daughter says she will enjoy it.

speaker: dad
statement: Dad says the grandchild loves it.
falseStatement: Dad says the grandchild is afraid of it.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Ọ ga-ahụ osisi na akwụkwọ osisi.
statement: The daughter says he will see trees and leaves.
falseStatement: The daughter says he will see flowers and birds.

speaker: daughter
englishText: He'll see a river and a mountain.
statement: The daughter says he will see a river and a mountain.
falseStatement: The daughter says he will see a lake and a forest.

speaker: daughter
igboText: O nwekwara ike ịhụ anyu, igwe ojii, na ifufe.
englishText: He might also see the sun, clouds, and wind.
statement: The daughter says he might also see sun, clouds, and wind.
falseStatement: The daughter says he might also see the moon, stars, and rain.

speaker: daughter
igboText: Ma ọ bụrụ na mmiri ozuzo adaa ma ọ bụ oke ifufe bịa, ọ ga-enwe ezigbo akụkọ ịkọ!
englishText: And if it rains or there's a storm, he'll have a great story to tell!
statement: The daughter says rain or storm could give him a great story to tell.
falseStatement: The daughter says if it snows or there's ice, he'll have a great story to tell!

speaker: daughter
igboText: Papa, gịnị ka ị chọrọ ịhụ?
englishText: Dad, what do you want to see?
statement: The daughter asks what Dad wants to see.
falseStatement: The daughter asks what the grandchild wants to see.

speaker: dad
igboText: Mụ? Achọrọ m ịnọ n'ụlọ. Ka nwa nwa m gaa hụ ihe ndị ahụ niile!
englishText: Me? I want to stay at home. Let my grandchild go see all those things!
statement: Dad says he wants to stay home and let his grandchild see those things.
falseStatement: Dad says he wants to go outside with the grandchild.
